question: Kelucharan Mohapatra, awarded with the Padma Vibhushan in the year 2000, was a dancer of which of the following classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a well-known** guru, performer, and exponent **of Indian classical dance.
 
• In the** 20th century**, he is credited with **bringing back and popularizing** this classical dancing style.
 
• He is the first recipient of** Odisha's Padma Vibhushan.**
 
• **Odissi dance:**
 
 
• The** temples of Odisha** are where the odissi dance had its start.
 
• Throughout its history,** women **predominately performed odissi.
 
• Through** songs**, it conveyed** spiritual and religious beliefs**, particularly those of **Vaishnavism.**
 
• The concepts of other traditions, such as those relating to the **Hindu Gods Shiva and Surya and Hindu Goddesses**, have also been conveyed through odissi performances.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali:**

 
 
• A significant type of **classical Indian dance** is kathakali.
 
• The** elaborately colorful make-up and costumes** set this "story play" kind of art apart.
 
• In **Kerala** between the **16th and 17th centuries,** kathakali first emerged.
 
 
 
• **Kathak:**
 
 
• One of the** eight primary styles** of Indian classical dance is kathak.
 
• It is an **Uttar Pradeshi c**lassical dance style.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**:
 
 
• One of the** eight principal **Indian traditional dance styles, the Manipuri Dance is a product of the **state of Manipur.**
 
• The spiritual themes of **Madhura Raas of Radha-Krishna** are infused into the dance style.
 
• **Gentle gaze and calm, serene body **movements define it.
